Carlos has Mesa Vista 4C down as wrapped from its June turn and wants it released for listing. Brooke is ready to put it on the market on his word. I am not signing off on it until I have run my own pass, so before anyone lists it I need the real state of that turn.

The unit moved out in the middle of June with a target-ready date at the end of the month, which has already come and gone. The two scopes that carried this turn were the deep clean and the interior repaint. I need to know whether both are genuinely closed and signed off or still open, and I want the vendor side reconciled too. A scope that is billed but not finished, or finished with the bill still sitting unpaid, does not count as closed to me. There is also a re-inspection on the calendar for the middle of this month, and it factors into whether I can call this one done.

When you have the actual picture, record your QC determination on that turn and give me the call: if it is genuinely marketing-ready, sign it off; if it is not, say so plainly and hold it, because it does not go to listing until every outstanding scope is closed and signed off. Open a ticket on the issue tracker spelling out exactly what is still left on it, post where it lands in the make-ready channel, and get an email together for Carlos with the specifics. If I am holding it back, Brooke needs to hear it from us before she markets it.
I will inspect the local report files and search relevant databases to assess the make-ready state
for Mesa Vista unit 4C.

parameters.description: Extract text from PDFs using pdfminer/pdfplumber/fitz.
parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import glob

def try_pdf(pdf_path):
    text = ''
    try:
        import fitz # PyMuPDF
        doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
        for page in doc: text += page.get_text()
        return text
    except Exception: pass
    try:
        import pdfplumber
        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
            for page in pdf.pages: text += page.extract_text() or ''
        return text
    except Exception: pass
    try:
        from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text
        return extract_text(pdf_path)
    except Exception: pass
    return text

for pdf in glob.glob('/workspace/company_files/**/*.pdf', recursive=True):
    txt = try_pdf(pdf)
    if '4C' in txt or 'Mesa Vista' in txt or 'Mesa' in txt or 'Pete' in txt or 'Sunshine' in txt:
        print(f'=== {pdf} ===')
        print(txt)
        print('-'*40)
"

Hi Carlos,

I have completed my Quality Control pass on the June make-ready turn for Mesa Vista Unit 4C. Based on my review of primary records across our systems, this unit is NOT marketing-ready and is being HELD from listing.

Jaime Salinas
Quality Control Inspector
Star Property Management
